triggers.name: execute
triggers.title: New call for function
triggers.help: Use this to build a recipe that can be called from another recipe Define the parameters for this recipe function ( parameters schema ) and the result returned to the parent recipe ( result schema ).

input.name: parameters_schema_json
input.label: Parameters schema
input.hint: Describe the schema for the recipe parameters

input.name: result_schema_json
input.label: Result schema
input.hint: Describe JSON schema for a recipe return value

actions.name: call_recipe
actions.title: Call a recipe function (synchronous)
actions.help: Call a recipe function . You can use the result from that call in your subsequent steps.

input.name: flow_id
input.label: Recipe function
input.hint: Only recipe functions can be called from another recipe. {{#if input.flow_id && recipeInfo.ownersView}} View selected recipe.{{/if}}

actions.name: call_recipe_async
actions.title: Call a recipe function (asynchronous)
actions.help: Call a recipe function to run asynchronously. This action will not wait for the call result and proceed with the next step. You will not be able to use the outputs of the called recipe function.

input.name: flow_id
input.label: Recipe function
input.hint: Only recipe functions can be called from another recipe. {{#if input.flow_id && recipeInfo.ownersView}} View selected recipe.{{/if}}

actions.name: return_result
actions.title: Return data from a recipe function
actions.help: Return data to the parent recipe. The schema for this result is described in the function call trigger.

actions.name: wait_for_async_jobs
actions.title: Wait for async calls
actions.description: Wait for an async call to complete

input.name: async_calls
input.label: Async calls to wait for
input.hint: Build a list of async recipe function calls job references

input.name: timeout
input.label: Timeout limit (minutes)
input.hint: Set an upper limit for this wait action. If one or more of the async jobs take longer than this, proceed to the next step without waiting. Maximum is 1440 minutes (24 hours). Passing zero here will be…
